prompt:
Create a high-fidelity landscape desktop web application screenshot (1440x960, no browser chrome) for an Advanced Databases assignment product catalogue. This is one composition variant of an already-approved visual world called “Specimen Register”; do not change its identity. It must look like a working CRUD interface, not poster art or a landing page. No photos or logos. Never invent IDs, dates, counts, metrics, rows, values, categories, product fields, or museum information.

Keep this exact design system: cool pale gray #F2F5F7 matte record surface, deep blue-black #18252D, cobalt #2457F5 used for action/selection, very small chartreuse #D7EF62 for stock status. Clean workhorse system sans; monospaced data and JSON. Flat label bands and precise accession-register alignment, but no fake paper grain, no serif, no cream, no terracotta, no glow, no blur.

Composition option “Catalogue-first spread”: compact top header with “Product catalogue”, small “Sample data” marker, and “Add product”. Under it show labeled Search and Category filter controls. A broad full-width product index occupies the upper half of the page, with columns Product, Category, Price (ZMW), Stock, Status; four exact rows:
Samsung Galaxy A15 | Phones | ZMW 2,800 | Stock 14 | In stock
Tecno Spark 20 | Phones | ZMW 2,100 | Stock 22 | In stock
iPhone 13 | Phones | ZMW 11,500 | Stock 4 | Low stock
Cotton T-Shirt | Clothing | ZMW 150 | Stock 60 | In stock
Select Samsung Galaxy A15. No other rows or counts.

Below the full-width index, create a selected record workspace with two equal subpanes: editable product fields on the left and a readable “MongoDB document” preview on the right. The edit fields and exact values are: Name Samsung Galaxy A15; Category Phones; Price 2800; Stock 14; Tags android and budget; Specs storage 128GB, ram 4GB, battery 5000mAh. Include Save product, Cancel, Delete actions. The JSON preview must be a nested object containing only name, category, price, stock, tags, specs and the same exact values; no ObjectId, no timestamp. At 1440x960, the page title, controls, four rows, form, and document preview all fit visibly without overlap. Keep typography legible at screenshot scale.
